intent: Architectural hero and transparent parallax layers based on actual River Green project photographs
initialPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: premium residential-colony website hero background, wide landscape 16:9. Primary request: transform the real River Green entrance photograph into a polished, photorealistic architectural visualisation for River Green Colony in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh. Input images: Image 1 entrance gate is the architectural identity target; Image 2 aerial gate photo is a supporting reference for the flanking low-rise white sales-office/shop wings and paved avenue; Image 3 fountain is a supporting reference for the real stone-cone circular basin, palms and clipped hedges. Preserve the distinctive tall rectangular off-white gate portal, its thin vertical fins, and the dark-green physical serif wordmark reading exactly "River Green" with the leaf above G. Keep the colony low-rise and authentic to these references. Refine the cream-and-muted-terracotta interlocking paving, planted edges, palms, lawns, black heritage streetlights and long entrance avenue. Remove people, utility wires, construction clutter, temporary banners and vehicles. Composition: a sophisticated slightly elevated three-quarter view of the entrance, gate on the right half and road receding through it; the left 40 percent is quiet foreground planting/paving and soft morning atmosphere, with no focal building, leaving usable space for website text. Lighting: natural warm morning sunlight, soft realistic shadows, pale blue sky, restrained lush greens, warm ivory stone, finely resolved materials. Make this an outstanding realistic property-development visual, photographic architectural quality rather than a toy diorama. No high-rise towers, no invented swimming pools, no excessive mansions, no mountains, no UI, no watermark, and no written text except the existing River Green gate sign. Render a continuous landscape image edge to edge, not a webpage mockup.
correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the generated River Green entrance architectural visualisation. Correct the colony geography: the circular stone fountain is INSIDE the colony, well beyond the entrance gate, never outside it. Remove the large fountain and its circular basin from the left foreground completely, and replace that area with a simple refined lawn, clipped hedges and cream-and-terracotta approach paving matching the rest of the scene. The foreground is an entrance forecourt. If the fountain is visible at all, it must be a small distant feature through the portal far along the internal avenue; do not put any fountain on the outside approach. Keep the gate on the right, exact "River Green" physical sign, white low-rise shop wings, vertical gate fins, architecture, camera composition, warm morning light, palms, street lights and overall realism unchanged. Keep the left side calm and spacious for website copy. No extra buildings, no new writing, no people, no cars, no watermark.
